title: Joab kills Abner in revenge
description: Joab returns from a military campaign and is displeased when he hears that David let Abner go in peace. He brings Abner back from the well of Sirah without David's knowledge, takes him aside at the gate of Hebron, and stabs him in the stomach as revenge for Abner having killed his brother Asahel. David declares himself and his kingdom innocent of this blood guilt and curses the house of Joab.
